source.text:
Hi! Emailing from work with a quick change for our bike pickup.

I just heard the shop is closing early next Saturday, Oct 31. Can we keep the same Saturday we arranged by text, but come at 10 am instead of the 2 pm we had? Same shop and same address, just earlier.

Let me know if that works!

Riley

Thanks for the heads-up!
